inputStateOwnership: Input is copied; sold may be a sorted ID array or ID=>true map. No production state is mutated.
tick: controller:tick(dtSeconds), normally called from OnUpdate(dt); source duration .13 seconds, CSS ease cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1).
reducedMotion: options.reducedMotion=true disables transitions, matching the approved prefers-reduced-motion rule.
nativeBindings: handlers[id].enter/leave/activate are exactly the functions bound to native cursor callbacks. Direct Lua calls are not genuine input-hit tests.
navigationOrder: Deactivate shop, increment generation, clear all motion/hover/brightness, hide shop, rebind stale-safe callbacks, create detached snapshot, invoke onNavigate once.
navigationOwner: Parent must display its intended map slice. This adapter never displays a substitute end page and does not prove connection to a production Run map.
externalDismissal: Call controller:destroy() before another owner replaces or leaves this room; late callbacks are invalidated.
reentry: controller:enter() retains this fixture's balance/sold state and creates a fresh generation. For a new approved room sample create a new controller instead.
